timing_methodology: Pair native session tool dispatch and result timestamps by call_id; union overlapping intervals.
Outside-tool time is task wall-clock time outside those intervals, not measured provider latency.
It includes model generation, provider queue/network/client overhead, compaction, and stalls.
Tool wait includes normal execution, sleeps, polling, and any resource contention; not a contention estimate.
Background commands may overlap outside-tool time. No continuous host-pressure or CPU-throttling telemetry is available.
Recorded implementation time minus native task time is a signed runner/clock residual, not measured overhead. Host and container clock intervals can differ slightly in either direction.
Astra and Sol 6 cover only fresh R2-R5 work; reused M1 is excluded. Luna covers all five releases. Sol 6.1 has no published interval breakdown because the newer CLI logs contain timestamp reversals.
